lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately three discernible horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank, forming a staggered grid pattern.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of subtly elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating grid-like anchor nodes primarily visible in the central third of the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature running horizontally along the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.
